steps.title: Read a shared page and its title property
steps.detail: Retrieve the page with the customer's access token, sending the Notion-Version header. The title is read from the properties object where a property has type title, and its text is in plain_text. Use the page ID the customer shared; a 404 means the page is not shared with the connection.
steps.doneWhen: The response returns the shared page's title text from the title property plain_text. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

evidence.quote: Response JSON paths for GET /v1/pages/{page_id}: $.properties.*.title[].plain_text (string)

steps.title: Read the page body as markdown
steps.detail: Retrieve the page content as markdown with markdown_version=v2. steps.doneWhen: The markdown is returned; truncated content is followed up by block ID or reported as inaccessible. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.
